## Checklist

- [ ] `make ci` passes
- [ ] New text is in the String Catalog in en, ja, pt-BR, and es (say if machine-translated)

- [ ] Works in airplane mode

- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` is updated, if a person would notice the change
- [ ] Screenshots use fictional data only

## Privacy

- [ ] Adds no network use outside `ModelDelivery` (or a paired connector)
- [ ] Adds no dependency, or `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` and the allowlist are updated
